slot.brief: Phenol + CHCl3/NaOH followed by hydrolysis: identify the product and the reaction name (Reimer–Tiemann).

stem: 4-Methylphenol is treated with $\text{CHCl}_3$ and aqueous $\text{NaOH}$, followed by hydrolysis and acidification. Identify the major product and reaction name.

verdicts.working: CHCl₃/aqueous NaOH followed by hydrolysis and acidification gives the Reimer–Tiemann reaction. Formylation ortho to the phenolic OH of 4-methylphenol gives 2-hydroxy-5-methylbenzaldehyde.

working:
$\text{CHCl}_3/\text{NaOH}$ generates $:\!\text{CCl}_2$; substitution occurs ortho to $-\text{OH}$.
The para position is occupied in 4-methylphenol, and the two ortho positions are equivalent.
Hydrolysis converts $-\text{CHCl}_2$ to $-\text{CHO}$.
Product: 2-hydroxy-5-methylbenzaldehyde; reaction: Reimer–Tiemann.
